def.label: Stock direct-fire resolution
def.note: Cut C's table. x is doc 16 section 3.5 step 3's angular_size_mrad * 1000 / error_mrad, so x = 1000 is a target exactly as wide as the error cone and the curve puts that at 350 per mille. The stock tank's 350 cm front at 1 km is 3.5 mrad against a 3 mrad cone at rest, x = 1166, about 40 per cent; the same shot at 2 km is 1.75 mrad against 6 mrad, x = 291, about 6 per cent. p_min 10 keeps a hopeless shot from being an arithmetic certainty of a miss (a lucky round exists) and p_max 950 keeps a point-blank shot from being a certainty of a hit. The four weights are per-mille multipliers cut W applies to its own measured terms; gunnery is 1000 because every stock rating is 1 through the PilotProfile seam.
